notes: shall ye have is placed on יִהְיֶה with the possessive לְ unrepresented and the subject pronoun on the suffix, per rule 43's first case, where a present הָיָה takes the have itself.

brought ... out keeps out with the Hiphil of יָצָא as its phrasal particle, leaving of to מִן. Reading out of as one multi-word rendering of מִן, headed on out under rule 24, was the competing reading; the Hiphil's own bring-out sense is what decided it.
